correctness_topical.explantion: Response a, while not perfect, stays focused on the core question about the danger of an untreated WBC >15,000 and cites several references that directly link such leukocytosis to serious outcomes (e.g., higher mortality and heart‑failure risk after MI). coherence_logical.explantion: Both responses suffer from structural problems and redundant statements, but response b adds an internal contradiction (claiming adults normally have higher WBC counts while also stating any count above 15,000 is abnormal). consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses suffer from blurred viewpoints, unresolved conflicts, false consensus, and attribution failures.
